integrity: The fixed-parameter Weyl coefficient is credited to a specialization of Birman–Solomyak; the endpoint finite part is proved by elliptic asymptotics and dominated convergence. Finite numerical checks are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Two-periodic nonnegative row multipliers. The singular-index limit is at fixed t<1 and the endpoint concerns its coefficient. No joint asymptotic, t=1 spectrum, or longer-period classification is claimed.
title: The endpoint finite part for two-periodic damping of generalized Cesàro singular values
